integrity: The exact integer recursion follows from a structural proof; independent finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-level induction.
scientific_limitations: Dyadic substitution prefixes only; no closed-form asymptotics, arbitrary-factor counts or claims about all minimal absent subsequences; unindexed equivalent trace formulas remain a literature risk.
title: Quadratic recurrence for shortest absent subsequences of Thue–Morse prefixes
